how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-darkshore-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1141:obj:0: Catch 6 ⟦E1⟧ Grouper for Gubber Blump in Auberdine.
rows.quest:1141:details:0: I love fishing. The Blump family is known for fishing. My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.
rows.quest:1141:details:1: BThere's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called ⟦E1⟧ grouper. I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in. I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.
rows.quest:1141:details:2: BSay, you wanna help me catch ⟦E1⟧ grouper? I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family ⟦E2⟧ Pole if you did! It's a real good pole to catch fish with.
rows.quest:1141:completion:0: Them's some real nice groupers, ⟦1⟧! Thanks for helping me out!
rows.quest:1141:completion:1: BYou're at least as good of a fisherman as my cousin, Graun Blump. She also has a beard and she smells kinda funny, but that don't do nothing to stop her fishing. I reckon you have what it takes to use a Blump Family ⟦E2⟧ Pole.
rows.quest:1143:obj:0: Kill Athrikus Narassin and bring his head to Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
rows.quest:1143:details:0: I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to strike. I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.
rows.quest:1143:completion:0: With the death of Athrikus, I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their threat.
rows.quest:1167:obj:0: Speak with Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
rows.quest:1167:details:0: Before confronting Athrikus, it would probably be wise for you to consult with Balthule. I have no doubt he has been vigilant in his watch of the Tower, and he may have information about recent developments.
rows.quest:1167:completion:0: Ah, it's good to see you again, ⟦2⟧! The strangest things have been happening around here, I'm glad you showed up!
rows.quest:1167:completion:1: BIt was very strange, ⟦3⟧. Everything seemed normal--well, as normal as things get around here--and then suddenly there was a blinding flash of light from the upper room of the tower. Then came the screams. The cries split the air, and lightning struck the ground from time to time. What's going on?
rows.quest:2078:obj:0: Find Gelkak's First Mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, and lead it back to Gelkak.
rows.quest:2078:details:0: Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.
rows.quest:2078:details:1: BTake this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.
rows.quest:2078:details:2: BThem murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!
rows.quest:2078:completion:0: Yarrr... Ye be provin' yerself to be more than a yella sea dog, landlubber.
rows.quest:2078:completion:1: BThe Cap'n may promote ye to poop deck swabby if ye be keepin' this up...
rows.quest:2098:obj:0: Find and return the three pieces of Gelkak's Key to Gelkak Gyromast.
rows.quest:2098:details:0: A pirate's life ain't an easy one, landlubber. It ain't all about plunderin' and booze! Alas, me ship be sunk just off shore thanks to them pesky Threshadons.
rows.quest:2098:details:1: BWhat I be needin' is me first mate back in workin' order!
rows.quest:2098:details:2: BWhen I washed up'n shore, the key for me first mate broke on the rocks and was pilfered by the beasties of ⟦E1⟧. Out of the corner of me eyes I saw some of them Ragin' Crawlers, Ferocious Foreststrider, and murloc rummaging through the wreckage....
rows.quest:2098:completion:0: Avast ye scurvy sea dog! Ye did it! Soon me first mate be back in workin' order and them beasties won't know what hit em!
rows.quest:2098:completion:1: BHrm, have ye seen me first mate?
rows.quest:2118:obj:0: Capture a living Rabid Thistle Bear and bring it back to Tharnariun.
rows.quest:2118:obj:1: BShould you fail to capture a Rabid Thistle Bear and lose your trap, return to Tharnariun Treetender and request another trap.
rows.quest:2118:details:0: A sickness spreads across the ⟦E1⟧, gripping the minds and bodies of all it touches.
rows.quest:2118:details:1: BThe Thistle Bears have been hit the hardest by this plague. The once noble beasts are now an instrument of destruction - rabid and frenzied. I may have a cure for this ailment.
rows.quest:2118:details:2: BTake this trap to the forest and lay it on the ground. Any Rabid Thistle Bear that crosses the light shall become docile for a short time. Once the bear is docile, it shall follow you. Lead it back here, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:2118:completion:0: Our work has only just begun, ⟦5⟧. Are you prepared for your next task?
rows.quest:2138:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ the forest of 20 Rabid Thistle Bears and return to Tharnariun Treetender in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2138:details:0: As I had feared, the cure does not work.
rows.quest:2138:details:1: BIt saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down.
rows.quest:2138:details:2: BReturn to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, ⟦6⟧. It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the damage the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.
rows.quest:2138:completion:0: You have done Auberdine a great service, ⟦7⟧, but your task is not yet complete.
rows.quest:2139:obj:0: Find and kill the Den Mother.
rows.quest:2139:details:0: The survival of our people and lands comes at unfortunate costs, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:2139:details:1: BYou have spilled the blood of nature's servants; many sick animals you have felled. The people of Auberdine are indebted to you, for the forest's pain is eased - even if only for a moment.
rows.quest:2139:details:2: BI have one final task for you, but be warned, you will have to kill again. It is my hope that this will be the last time I call upon you, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:2139:details:3: BIn a cave to the northeast, near Bashal'Aran, resides the Den Mother. Slay her.
rows.quest:2139:completion:0: You have fought for Auberdine with bravery and honor, ⟦10⟧. In our war torn lands, death and despair are common. Many will not rise to meet the challenge of life in our new home, choosing instead to hide in their homes or escape to the more fortified lands of the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2139:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦11⟧. Perhaps someday soon we shall fight along side as comrades versus another foe.
rows.quest:3524:obj:0: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:3524:details:0: Majestic sea creatures are known to launch themselves at the ⟦E1⟧ coastline, beached there until they die. Lately, these beasts have been washing ashore in ever-increasing numbers. I've been sent here by the Temple of the Moon to investigate, but the presence of murlocs along the water has made my research difficult.
rows.quest:3524:details:1: BThere is a giant creature washed ashore just south of Auberdine that is ringed by the foul Greymist murlocs. Could you go there and retrieve bones from the creature for our study?
rows.quest:3524:completion:0: I hope the murloc did not give you much trouble in collecting this for us! I will be sure to get this on the next hippogryph to ⟦E5⟧. The Temple of the Moon has given me some funds to hand out for assistance; please have some with our thanks.
rows.quest:3524:completion:1: BYour success here emboldens me to offer you a chance to aid the Temple of the Moon further, if you are interested...
rows.quest:4681:obj:0: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4681:details:0: That beached creature is not an isolated incident here in ⟦E1⟧. There are more along the coastline and even in the water. I would like for you to investigate another one that we know of; this one was reported to be in the water due west of Auberdine, close to a sunken vessel. Return to me with anything that you may recover that would aid our research.
rows.quest:4681:details:1: BAlso, in your travels you may find other creatures. By all means, if you should discover anything then please bring it to our attention!
rows.quest:4681:completion:0: You've been a tremendous help here today; we now have a solid chance at unlocking the mystery of why these creatures choose to beach themselves on the cost of ⟦E1⟧. The idea that they might be fleeing the area around ⟦E6⟧ is disturbing. Should you come across others in your travels, please let me know. Our research here is but in its infancy.
rows.quest:4681:completion:1: BOn behalf of the Temple of the Moon, please accept this as thanks for the effort you have given. Thank you, ⟦12⟧!
rows.quest:4722:obj:0: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4722:details:0: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of ⟦E1⟧ some time ago. It has been scavenged by the murlocs who have encamped themselves around the creature's remains. Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
rows.quest:4722:completion:0: Another discovery for us to research - well done ⟦13⟧! These remains will be properly studied once they get to ⟦E5⟧. Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
rows.quest:4723:obj:0: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4723:details:0: The remains of a giant thresher - much larger than one you'd expect to find in ⟦E1⟧ - lie beached on the coast of the Mist's Edge. How this creature came to be here is unknown; the group of murlocs that now feast off the carcass of it seem to be much too weak, even in large numbers, to have brought down the beast.
rows.quest:4723:details:1: BWhile some of it has been picked clean, enough of it remains to take a sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine to study.
rows.quest:4723:completion:0: The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of ⟦E6⟧. They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to. Why would these creatures do this, I wonder? Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.
rows.quest:4723:completion:1: BAgain, thank you for your aid. Please accept this honorarium from the Temple of the Moon.
rows.quest:4725:obj:0: Take the Strangely Marked Box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4725:details:0: More sea turtle remains lie beached along the coastline. This particular set has an abandoned carriage attached to the turtle's shell. Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested. Greymist murlocs now make the remains of this creature their home, feasting off the carrion.
rows.quest:4725:details:1: BIn the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.
rows.quest:4725:completion:0: I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of the turtle you found. Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in battle and in transportation of their supplies on to land. The markings on the box you found are of the naga; this would explain their invasive presence in far-northern ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4725:completion:1: BI will send this box to ⟦E5⟧ along with the rest of your discoveries. This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
rows.quest:4727:obj:0: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4727:details:0: The skeletal remains of a sea turtle lie in the sand of the northern ⟦E1⟧ beaches. The Greymist murlocs have either not found this carcass, or perhaps they have and are shying away from it for some unknown reason. Regardless, there is enough of the turtle left to take a sample back to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon to study.
rows.quest:4727:completion:0: You've found even more beached creatures, ⟦14⟧? Sea turtles were commonly found frolicking along the base of Nordrassil before it was destroyed. With the birth of ⟦E6⟧, however, these creatures have been seen in ever decreasing numbers. Some, as we have discovered, end their lives here for some unknown reason.
rows.quest:4727:completion:1: BYour aid will perhaps unlock the mystery before us. Please accept this in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
rows.quest:4728:obj:0: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4728:details:0: The corpse of what appears to be some sort of giant sea mammal lies partially gutted on the beach. A wheelbarrow and various tools lie abandoned by this enormous beached sea creature, as though an attempt to study it had been made previously. Though murlocs have scavenged this beast, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4728:completion:0: Ah, I believe you discovered one that was originally being examined by the Explorer's League. They have a presence here in ⟦E1⟧, and they had mentioned that they were studying one of the beached creatures until they were chased out by the murlocs. You appear to have succeeded where we both have not. Please - accept this honorarium on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.
rows.quest:4730:obj:0: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4730:details:0: The half-devoured corpse of what might have been a giant sea mammal lies on the beach. A band of murlocs, stronger than those found closer to Auberdine, have taken up residence around the fallen creature. Enough of the creature remains that a suitable sample of its bones could be delivered to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4730:completion:0: The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of ⟦E6⟧. They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to. Why would these creatures do this, I wonder? Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.
rows.quest:4730:completion:1: BAgain, thank you for your aid. Please accept this honorarium from the Temple of the Moon.
rows.quest:4731:obj:0: Take the Strangely Marked Box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4731:details:0: Another set of sea turtle remains lie beached on the coastline. This set of remains has an abandoned carriage half buckled to the turtle's shell. Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested. Powerful Greymist murlocs have made the carcass of this creature their current home.
rows.quest:4731:details:1: BIn the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.
rows.quest:4731:completion:0: I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of that turtle. Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in battle and in transportation of their supplies on to land. The markings on the box you found are of the naga; perhaps the creature you discovered was killed as it was heading further south... to ⟦E7⟧ maybe?
rows.quest:4731:completion:1: BI will be sure to send this box to ⟦E5⟧ with the rest of your discoveries. This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
rows.quest:4732:obj:0: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4732:details:0: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of ⟦E1⟧ some time ago. It has been picked nearly clean by Greymist murlocs, the very ones who now have encamped themselves around the creature's remains. Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
rows.quest:4732:completion:0: You've found even more beached creatures, ⟦15⟧? Sea turtles were commonly found frolicking along the base of Nordrassil before it was destroyed. With the birth of ⟦E6⟧, however, these creatures have been seen in ever decreasing numbers. Some, as we have discovered, end their lives here for some unknown reason.
rows.quest:4732:completion:1: BYour aid will perhaps unlock the mystery before us. Please accept this in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
rows.quest:4733:obj:0: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4733:details:0: The remains of what appear to be a giant thresher have washed ashore on the rocky inlet of the Twilight ⟦E8⟧. The thresher is several times larger than any of the other threshers spotted in these parts. Wherever it came from, this creature would not seem to have been native to ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4733:details:1: BThough the creature has been picked apart in places, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4733:completion:0: The dimensions of the thresher you mention are mind-boggling. Even the eldest of the threshers in this region grow to only a fraction of that size. While some larger ones were known to be close to ⟦E6⟧, their numbers have declined steadily. I cannot help but wonder if these creatures beaching themselves here are somehow related to this.
rows.quest:4733:completion:1: BWhile we analyze the bones you have brought us, please accept this on behalf of the Temple of the Moon. Thank you, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:4740:obj:0: Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water.
rows.quest:4740:obj:1: BReport the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4740:details:1: BA reward is being offered for the death of the murloc "Murkdeep". This foul beast is known to be responsible for the death of at least one Sentinel, and is suspected of causing the sinking of at least two cargo vessels in the waters off ⟦E1⟧!
rows.quest:4740:details:2: BMurkdeep was last spotted at a hutted murloc camp south of Auberdine, and is thought to be protecting the huts there. Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4740:completion:0: Well, looks like you're here to more than just inquire! The citizens will be delighted to know that tonight they will sleep a little bit more soundly and safer.
rows.quest:4740:completion:1: BYou've acted as the executioner of justice for the people of Auberdine today, ⟦17⟧. For that, I would like to offer you this as a suitable reward... for a true hero of the Auberdine people.
rows.quest:4761:obj:0: Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4761:details:0: Your scouting of the furbolg camp is information that Thundris Windweaver should be made aware of. He graciously serves as the elder of Auberdine, offering sage and just stewardship of the day to day affairs of the village. Please - share with him your findings to date on the furbolg situation.
rows.quest:4761:details:1: BI believe he has some ideas of his own on the reasons behind their corruption. Perhaps you can work with him to enact a plan to restore the balance of nature here!
rows.quest:4761:completion:0: Well met, ⟦18⟧. Your scouting of the furbolg situation comes at a fortuitous time for us in Auberdine. For some time we have dealt with not only forest dwellers who are now openly hostile to our presence, but also the outright corruption of the forest itself. Hopefully you might be able to lend Auberdine aid during these troubling times.
rows.quest:4762:obj:0: ⟦E9⟧ north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there.
rows.quest:4762:obj:1: BReturn to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.
rows.quest:4762:details:0: The Cliffspring River has begun turning foul and corrupted. It empties into the Mist's Edge, and I fear the wash will affect Auberdine soon. I suspect the Blackwood furbolgs up-river are the cause of the taint, but I also suspect that they aren't the true root of it.
rows.quest:4762:details:1: BTake this sampling tube and go to the mouth of the river to our north. Proceed inland to the first waterfall and draw a sample from the pool there. You'll see a bridge overhead. Once you have a sample, return to me in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4762:completion:0: It's no surprise how tainted this water is, but just look at how putrid it is becoming! It would seem that action is needed sooner than later, eh ⟦19⟧?
rows.quest:4762:completion:1: BTo our east is ⟦E10⟧; it is the real source of this corruption, one that I have seen in times past. I predict this sample will confirm this. We might be able to enact a cure for it here, but in order to even try we will need assistance. When that time comes ⟦20⟧, I hope you will be able to give the aid we need.
rows.quest:4763:obj:0: Fill the Empty ⟦E11⟧ Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
rows.quest:4763:obj:1: BGather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.
rows.quest:4763:obj:2: BMix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.
rows.quest:4763:obj:3: BTake the Talisman of ⟦E12⟧ and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4763:details:0: We've learned that a source of furbolg corruption is from the satyr. They hold sway via talismans that they channel magic through. If the furbolg have a chance at ⟦E13⟧, we must lure out the satyr corruptor and take that talisman!
rows.quest:4763:details:1: BFill this bowl at our moonwell and take samples of the furbolgs' food from their northern camp. Mix them and place it near the bonfire by the river; any furbolgs who eat will be cleansed just long enough to lure out the satyr corruptor... who then you must slay!
rows.quest:4763:completion:0: We have just begun this war to reclaim our forest from the forces of corruption, but a battle this day has been won! ⟦21⟧, the people of Auberdine owe you a debt of gratitude that will never be easily repaid. Please accept this along with our thanks. What we have learned here today may one day free our furbolg friends from the shackles of torment permanently.
rows.quest:4811:obj:0: ⟦E9⟧ east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along ⟦E1⟧'s eastern mountain range. Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4811:details:0: Hostile moonkin roam in ever increasing numbers to our east. They once were thought to be gentle, almost mystical creatures. While some continue to hold reverence for them, the safety of Auberdine forces me to keep a more realistic view.
rows.quest:4811:details:1: BI've received reports that moonkin are being drawn to a large red crystal along ⟦E1⟧'s eastern mountain range. No one has any idea what that crystal is, or even if it really exists. I want you to locate it over there and report back to me what you find.
rows.quest:4811:completion:0: So the crystal exists, ⟦22⟧? Fascinating... anyway, your task has been well executed; good work!
rows.quest:4811:completion:1: BWhat exactly is this crystal? This is but a single question in a sea of questions. Another question that comes to mind is why the moonkin would be drawn to this object? Is the crystal benign in nature, or does it hold a more sinister purpose?
rows.quest:4811:completion:2: BI have many more questions, but we're going to need to examine that crystal closely to get some answers.
rows.quest:4812:obj:0: Fill the Empty Water Tube at the Auberdine moonwell, and then investigate the red crystal along ⟦E1⟧'s eastern mountain wall.
rows.quest:4812:details:0: Use this empty vial and fill up on some moonwell water here in Auberdine. Such potent magic should provide a clue as to the composition of the crystal. To do that, you'll pour the liquid over the crystal; it should take care of the rest.
rows.quest:4812:details:1: BWhile I don't anticipate anything bad happening to you, I still want you to be careful. Above us to the east is ⟦E10⟧; if that crystal is tied to that place as I suspect it is, then it could prove to be very dangerous.
rows.quest:4812:completion:0: You have made it once more to the mysterious crystal. Removing the stopper on the tube of moonwell water, you gingerly pour the contents out over the top of the crystal. As the water cascades down its lattices, you see the opaque surface turn transparent...
rows.quest:4813:obj:0: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4813:details:0: The moonwell water has revealed that embedded inside the crystal are a few small fragments of bone, as well as half of a jawbone. The jawbone appears to be from a humanoid, but it is unclear without breaking open the crystal - a feat that even the strongest of magic would find near impossible.
rows.quest:4813:details:1: BWith the task at hand complete, all that remains is to report back to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
rows.quest:4813:completion:0: Well, it would seem that even though we know more about this crystal, more unanswered questions are the result!
rows.quest:4813:completion:1: BI'll take the information you've uncovered to the council here in Auberdine. Perhaps they'll know a course of action to follow on this crystal. Well, that is if there is one to be taken; for now, the threat remains far enough to our east to be out of harm's way.
rows.quest:4813:completion:2: BAs for you, please have this. Consider it a reward for a job well done, ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:5321:obj:0: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:5321:details:0: I was on my way to Maestra's Post to meet Liladris Moonriver, but I decided to stop here and take a short nap. Ever since I awoke from the emerald dream, I have been so sleepy...
rows.quest:5321:details:2: BWould you mind showing me the way? I understand that Maestra's Post is south of here, along the road in ⟦E7⟧. It can be dangerous, so I hope you have some friends that will join us.
rows.quest:5321:details:3: BLastly, I may fall asleep so if you ever need to wake me, please use my horn. You'll find it in the chest here.
rows.quest:5321:completion:0: Oh, I am so happy Kerlonian made it! And I'm sure I'll find him sleeping somewhere around here, won't I?
rows.quest:5321:completion:1: BThank you for showing him the way, ⟦25⟧.
rows.quest:5713:obj:0: Protect Sentinel Aynasha, then speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:5713:details:0: I was traveling to Auberdine with an important message when I was attacked by the furbolg Marosh and his trackers. During the attack I was poisoned, leaving me barely able to stand. I can make an antidote, but it will take time before it is ready.
rows.quest:5713:details:1: BI would ask that you defend me until I can apply the antidote. I will aid you with my bow as best I can.
rows.quest:5713:details:2: BShould we survive, I will be able deliver my message to Auberdine, while you speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post to inform her of this incident.
rows.quest:5713:completion:0: You bring most welcome news ⟦26⟧. It is good to hear that Aynasha is alive and well thanks to you. I would hope that you might accept a reward for your valor. May ⟦E14⟧ watch over you and light your path.
rows.quest:6341:details:0: The fishermen of Rut'theran village do very well, for the fish here are extremely large and abundant. I would like to compare the bounty here with that of the mainland.
rows.quest:6341:details:1: BI have a collection of fish bones and scales that I would like taken to a colleague of mine in ⟦E1⟧. His name is Laird, he is a fish vendor in the village of Auberdine.
rows.quest:6341:details:2: BBring my collection to our hippogryph master, Vesprystus, and speak to him about traveling to Auberdine.
rows.quest:6341:completion:0: Ah, you wish to get this to Auberdine? Very well...
rows.quest:6342:obj:0: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
rows.quest:6342:details:0: From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph. Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.
rows.quest:6342:details:1: BIt is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one. Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.
rows.quest:6342:details:2: BHere is Nessa's collection. Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.
rows.quest:6342:completion:0: A package from Nessa? Thank you, ⟦27⟧! She told me she would send me samples of the fish caught near Rut'theran village. She thinks they may be very different from the fish caught here...
rows.quest:6342:completion:1: BMy! This jawbone is nearly twice the size of the same fish found here. And these scales are as big as a closed fist! Amazing!
rows.quest:6343:obj:0: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.
rows.quest:6343:details:0: I must send a response to Nessa. She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along ⟦E6⟧'s coastline. We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!
rows.quest:6343:details:1: BPlease, take this response to Nessa. If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather. If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.
rows.quest:6343:completion:0: This is very interesting. The fish here are large, but I didn't think the difference in bounties between here and the mainland was so great. There must be a reason for this...
rows.quest:6343:completion:1: BWell thank you, ⟦28⟧. I will discuss with the villagers the news you brought. Perhaps, one day, we will find the root of this oddity. But until then, we shall reap its benefits!
